ideas.pitch: An AI-powered AST extension that parses API definitions and automatically flags common OWASP Top 10 flaws like broken object-level authorization (BOLA).
ideas.title: VulnerabilityLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world application security directly by providing instant, actionable vulnerability analysis, matching the technical depth seen in winning log analysis dashboards.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web app scenario trainer designed to test developer understanding of authentication versus authorization flaws in microservices.
ideas.title: AuthGuard Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the challenge theme of testing practical security scenarios with an exceptionally polished and educational UX.

ideas.pitch: An automated anomaly detection tool that parses web server logs to surface subtle exploitation attempts in real time.
ideas.title: LogSleuth AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built on proven hackathon-winning architectures that merge log parsing with AI anomaly detection for immediate utility.

ideas.pitch: A repository scanning utility that generates codebase security reports and highlights missing input validation checks.
ideas.title: SecureScope Repo Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical approach of 1st-place documentation and code analysis tools by automating security insights.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight API gateway middleware enforcing strict defense-in-depth validation to prevent prompt injection and authorization bypass.
ideas.title: APIShield Defense Proxy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a defense-in-depth architecture that judges favor for robust security engineering.
